definitions.explanation: A collective term for seeds, bulbs, and young plants used for propagation in agriculture, horticulture, and forestry.

examples.japanese: {種苗|しゅびょう}を{購入|こうにゅう}する。
{春|はる}になると{種苗店|しゅびょうてん}はにぎわう。
examples.english: Seed shops become bustling when spring arrives.

examples.japanese: {新品種|しんひんしゅ}の{種苗|しゅびょう}は{種苗法|しゅびょうほう}によって{保護|ほご}されている。
examples.english: Seeds and seedlings of new varieties are protected by the Plant Variety Protection and Seed Act.

notes:
Combines {種|しゅ} (seed) and {苗|びょう} (seedling). Used primarily in agriculture, gardening, and legal contexts. In everyday conversation, people more often say {種|たね} (seeds) or {苗|なえ} (seedlings) separately.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {種苗店|しゅびょうてん}: seed and seedling shop
- {種苗法|しゅびょうほう}: Plant Variety Protection and Seed Act
- {種苗|しゅびょう}{会社|かいしゃ}: seed company
- {種苗|しゅびょう}の{生産|せいさん}: production of planting stock
- {種苗|しゅびょう}{交換会|こうかんかい}: seed exchange event

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {種|たね}: seed — everyday word for individual seeds
- {苗|なえ}: seedling, young plant — everyday word for transplantable young plants
- {苗木|なえぎ}: sapling, nursery tree — specifically young trees for transplanting
